environment.gpu: OrayIddDriver Device; Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics

measurement.append: sum of append/continuation + processHistory + publish calls; excludes generation/hash/pacing
measurement.ingest_cpu: process user+kernel including worker, corpus generation, hash, ingestion and settle; not receive CPU
measurement.scan: before cold-cache sampling: sequential cursor reads + chars[0] checksum; excludes full-field verification
measurement.throughput: Cell storage MiB/s (sizeof(Cell)); not transport byte throughput
measurement.cold: one distinct sampled block each, CacheOnly request to Found; includes worker scheduling; not GUI frame
measurement.memory: resident_charge before reads; RSS after ingestion; peak RSS includes corpus batch/read/verification
measurement.percentiles: nearest rank per process; summary gives median/min/max of process percentiles
measurement.close: idle store destruction and idle service stop; excludes queued-work close latency
